footer_credit: AI-Assisted Telemedicine Kiosk | Multilingual & Voice-Enabled Healthcare System
about_p1: The AI-Assisted Telemedicine Kiosk is designed to bridge the healthcare divide in rural India by providing accessible, multilingual, and AI-supported primary care consultations.
about_p2: Patients can record their symptoms using text or voice in their native language (English, Hindi, Kannada, Telugu). A supervised Random Forest model categorizes urgency to support attending physicians.
about_p3: Physicians can review prioritized queues, initiate encrypted WebRTC video calls, log clinical observations, and issue digital prescriptions saved to the patient's longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR).
about_disclaimer: Important Clinical Disclaimer: The machine learning triage model provides decision-support and urgency categorization only. It does not provide medical diagnoses or replace licensed healthcare practitioners.
help_step1: 1. Language Selection: Choose your preferred regional language for all prompts and voice output.
help_step2: 2. Patient Registration / Login: Enter your basic contact and demographic details to create or access your Health ID.
help_step3: 3. Symptom Entry (Text or Voice): Describe what you are experiencing via keyboard or microphone.
help_step4: 4. Voice Transcription & Review: Check the transcribed symptoms before confirming submission.
help_step5: 5. Preliminary AI Triage: View the urgency level and clinical decision-support assessment.
help_step6: 6. Waiting Room: Monitor your queue token while the attending doctor reviews your file.
help_step7: 7. Live Video Consultation: Connect directly with the doctor via WebRTC audio/video.
help_step8: 8. Digital Prescription & EHR: View doctor advice, medication schedule, and complete health history.
help_mic_issue: Microphone not working? Ensure browser microphone permissions are enabled in site settings. You can always type your symptoms in text mode.
help_cam_issue: Camera not opening? Allow video camera access when prompted by the browser for the WebRTC consultation.
consent_p1: Before proceeding, please note how your health information will be processed:
consent_bullet1: Your symptoms and basic details are stored securely in your patient electronic health record.
consent_bullet2: The AI model performs preliminary urgency assessment to assist the doctor.
consent_bullet3: The attending doctor conducts the formal clinical consultation and provides official medical guidance.
consent_checkbox: I understand and consent to proceed with the consultation.
